GOING BACK HOME.
A lone Austrian soldier, involved home, seated on the steps of a railroad carriage at Hallsberg, Sweden, waiting for the train to start for his native land.

Through the courtesy of the Swedish Government he has been exchanged, being listed as unfit for further service. Leaving his home a hole, hrasty man, he returns a cripple, a wreck of the war, who must begin life anew; crutches must henceforth serve as substitutes for the missing members. His work is done, his sacrifice is great but not to great for the Father-land. 4/14/16.
